images.prompt: A diagram illustrating the concept of pooling of losses. On the left, individual houses with a small chance of fire, each facing a large potential loss. On the right, the same houses contributing to a central "pool" of funds, showing that when one house burns, the loss is covered by the collective fund, making the individual financial impact much smaller. Arrows show contributions to the pool and payments from the pool.
